description: Create or update triageEvalCases in bulk — pass every case in ONE call, including a full corpus. Each case needs `input` (the ticket text) and `expectedType` (incident / bug / enhancement / misconfiguration / new_feature); `expectedTeamId` is optional and, when set, ALSO scores routing accuracy. Pass an existing case's `id` to update it in place — re-uploading the same corpus updates rather than duplicates. Returns `created` (the cases that saved) and `errors` (per-index validation failures) — a bad row does not fail the whole batch.

expectedAction.description: Optional exact recommended-action text to score; this never executes an action.

expectedRepoFullName.description: Optional owner/name repository prediction to score.

expectedTeamId.description: Optional — set to also score routing accuracy.

asOf.description: Absolute UTC evidence cutoff for this case.

snapshotIds.description: Immutable IDs returned when supplied evidence was saved.

id.description: Omit to create a new case; pass an existing id to update it.

input.description: The ticket description this case classifies.

name: anyforge_upsert_triage_eval_cases
title: Upsert triage eval cases
